summary_en: This Phase III trial tests adding pembrolizumab, an immunotherapy, to usual chemotherapy for non-small cell lung cancer in stage II or III that has been removed by surgery. Patients get one of four platinum-based chemotherapy regimens IV for up to 4 cycles, each 21 days apart, with pembrolizumab IV over 25 to 40 minutes on day 1 of each cycle, followed by pembrolizumab alone every 21 days for 13 cycles or every 6 weeks for 12 cycles for patients enrolled after 10/14/2020. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; it is a Phase III study.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase III evalúa agregar pembrolizumab, una inmunoterapia, a la quimioterapia habitual para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas en etapa II o III que fue extirpado por cirugía. Los pacientes reciben uno de cuatro regímenes de quimioterapia a base de platino por vena (IV) durante hasta 4 ciclos, cada 21 días, con pembrolizumab IV durante 25 a 40 minutos el día 1 de cada ciclo, seguido de pembrolizumab solo cada 21 días por 13 ciclos o cada 6 semanas por 12 ciclos para los pacientes inscritos después del 14/10/2020. La medida de resultado principal no se indica en el registro; es un estudio de fase III.
who_for: Lung cancer completely removed by surgery, stage IIA, IIB, IIIA, or IIIB, with clear margins
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 1
Enrolled 30 to 77 days after surgery, with no prior treatment for this lung cancer
Local tests show no EGFR exon 19 deletion or L858R, and no ALK rearrangement (non-squamous only)
Blood counts, kidney function, and liver tests within the stated limits
not_for: Known N2 lymph node disease before surgery
Uncontrolled illness, such as serious active infection or symptomatic heart failure
Current pneumonitis, or past non-infectious pneumonitis that needed steroids
Active autoimmune disease that needed systemic treatment in the last 2 years
